areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Programme promotes climate adaptation and mitigation, mainly regarding natural disasters and extreme hydrological events, with intensified environmental monitoring.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Measures reduce vulnerability to hydrological risks, following the state water-resources plan, with works and risk monitoring.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Risk maps for school and health units plus expansion of a school civil-defence programme, both included in the indicators.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Innovative technology drives the climate-risk monitoring component, including an early-warning system for climate-related disasters.
